title: Embodied Intelligence for Automated Chemical Titration
description: An automated titration framework that combines robotic liquid handling and real-time pH feedback to deliver accurate, repeatable, and safe chemical experiments.
details:
## Overview
This project presents an embodied intelligence–based approach to automated acid–base titration, replacing traditional burettes with low-cost droppers precisely controlled by a robotic platform. The method achieves high-precision titration performance comparable to trained laboratory personnel while significantly simplifying experimental procedures.
## Key Contributions
The robot performs stable and repeatable liquid dispensing with real-time pH sensing, enabling accurate titration curve generation and reliable equivalence-point detection. By minimizing human intervention, the approach reduces operational errors and enhances laboratory safety, offering a cost-effective and scalable solution for scientific research and education.

title: AI-Powered Virtual Human Video Generation
description: Automatically generating expressive, speaker-driven presentation videos from portraits, slides, scripts, and backgrounds, enabling fast, scalable, and personalized content creation.
details:
## Overview
This project explores an AI-driven approach to virtual human video creation, transforming simple inputs such as portrait images, presentation slides, and written scripts into expressive, speaker-led videos with synchronized audio and visuals.
## Impact
By eliminating the need for professional filming and complex production pipelines, the approach enables fast, scalable, and personalized video creation, making high-quality presentation videos as accessible and efficient as preparing slides.

title: Intelligent Sandplay for Psychological Assessment
description: Leveraging comprehensive data capture and AI-driven analysis to enhance the reliability, scalability, and safety of sandplay-based psychological evaluation in educational settings.
details:
## Overview
This project addresses key limitations of traditional psychological sandplay assessment, including incomplete data recording, subjective analysis, and privacy concerns, by introducing an intelligent, data-driven workflow aligned with mental health and AI initiatives.
## Outcomes
Through comprehensive data capture and AI-assisted analysis, the project supports human–machine collaborative diagnosis, providing counselors with reliable decision support and students with personalized psychological assessment, significantly improving the quality and efficiency of psychological intervention.
